answer: Physical Co-Location Attestation. Each identity must submit a hardware-signed pulse from a unique, sealed location beacon; the signature includes device-measured lagoon humidity and a nebula sky-brightness hash bound to that site. Beacons are tamper-resistant and single-issue, so one operator cannot produce two valid signatures without two physical sites. Attacker cost: one beacon plus a real distinct location per identity, making mass sybil creation capital- and logistics-bound.
